approval_basis.source: current user standing request to execute the captured work pack
approval_basis.scope: SWU-TSGR-005 exact three declared shared-path updates
approval_basis.regenerability_treatment: deterministic staged updates reduce decision cost only while baseline conflict detection, owner admission, public boundary, no publication, and consequence-free application remain proven

obligations.summary: Execute exactly SWU-TSGR-005 reconcile and classify.
Bind the passing SWU-TSGR-004 terminal result and joined closeout receipt.
Verify executor evidence, declared writes, outputs, and critical validation without applying live bytes.
Classify every target exactly apply, already-present-exact-output, or conflict.
Block undeclared or missing paths and unmet acceptance-critical validation.
Make output-only re-admission explicit and stop at reconciled.
Exclude live apply, commit, terminal write, and resume behavior.

constraints: Execute exactly one SWU in this Task Session.
Update only the three admitted shared runner paths.
Block if any live shared target changes from its preflight digest before apply.
Do not implement SWU-TSGR-006 or later behavior.
Do not apply reconciled outputs to live targets.
Do not update generated mirrors, publish, promote, commit, push, or deploy.
Persist the terminal Task Session result only after live validation and allowed-write reconciliation.

done_criteria.criterion: Every target is exactly apply, already-present-exact-output, or conflict.
The phase ends at reconciled without live apply.
